item.title: A First Birthday Worth Celebrating at EVAC North in Forres
item.description: Erskine Veterans Activity Centre North in Forres has marked its first anniversary with a celebration bringing together nearly 100 members, highlighting a year of community, support, and connection for veterans across Moray and the north of Scotland.The post A First Birthday Worth Celebrating at EVAC North in Forres appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A Well Proportioned Family Home in Milton of Leys, Inverness
item.description: Set in Milton of Leys on the south side of Inverness, this well proportioned family home offers flexible living space, a private garden, and easy access to schools, amenities, and the city, making it a practical place to settle.The post A Well Proportioned Family Home in Milton of Leys, Inverness appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Yellow Weather Warning Issued for Tuesday as Rain and Snow Set to Hit The Highlands
item.description: A yellow weather warning is in place for the Highlands and Eilean Siar on Tuesday from 6am to 11.59pm as heavy rain and snow are forecast to bring travel disruption, flooding risk, and difficult conditions on higher routes.The post Yellow Weather Warning Issued for Tuesday as Rain and Snow Set to Hit The Highlands appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Aberdeen MSP Calls for End to Energy Tax as Jobs and Confidence Fall
item.description: An Aberdeen MSP has called for an end to Labour’s Energy Profits Levy after new figures showed business confidence in the North East has slumped, with firms warning of falling profits, job losses, and growing pressure on Scotland’s energy sector.The post Aberdeen MSP Calls for End to Energy Tax as Jobs and Confidence Fall appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Council Expands in House Bus Network to Protect Key Inverness Routes
item.description: The Highland Council has expanded its in house bus network to protect key Inverness routes after Stagecoach confirmed service withdrawals, with new routes launching to maintain access, reliability, and essential public transport links for communities.The post Council Expands in House Bus Network to Protect Key Inverness Routes appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Consultation Launched on New Plan to Make Moray More Active
item.description: A public consultation has launched on Active Moray, a new long term strategy aiming to make physical activity part of everyday life, tackle health inequalities, and support healthier communities across Moray through partnership working and local engagement.The post Consultation Launched on New Plan to Make Moray More Active appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A9 Traffic Management Update Ahead of Drainage Works
item.description: Temporary traffic signals and short lane closures will be in place at two locations on the A9 from 2 February to allow drainage works to be carried out safely, with drivers advised to plan ahead and allow extra time for journeys.The post A9 Traffic Management Update Ahead of Drainage Works appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Appeal After Series of Housebreakings Across Wick
item.description: Police are investigating a series of linked housebreakings across Wick after multiple businesses and properties were targeted over several mornings, with officers appealing for information and urging residents to remain vigilant.The post Appeal After Series of Housebreakings Across Wick appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Rural AI Roadshow Brings Practical Technology to Inverness Businesses
item.description: The Rural AI Roadshow has launched in Inverness, offering rural businesses practical and affordable ways to use artificial intelligence, with real world examples, hands on sessions, and clear ideas designed to support growth, productivity, and sustainable rural economies.The post Rural AI Roadshow Brings Practical Technology to Inverness Businesses appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A Traditional Lewis Home Overlooking Port of Ness Harbour
item.description: Overlooking Port of Ness Harbour, this traditional home in Eorodale offers flexible living, sea views, and a strong sense of place at the northern edge of the Isle of Lewis, where coastal life and community remain closely connected.The post A Traditional Lewis Home Overlooking Port of Ness Harbour appeared first on The Highland Times.
